metadata.name: Baz Goal Catalogue
metadata.purpose: Blueprint catalogue for long-lived retail financial goals, milestones, dependencies and overlaps.
metadata.guiding_principle: Life circumstances create goals. Goals create milestones. Needs and products are tools used to achieve those goals.

rules: Discovery is not activation: customer consent is required before a candidate goal becomes a persistent plan.
A goal may be relevant without being appropriate to surface immediately.
Goals may overlap and share facts or milestones.
The same financial resource must not be silently allocated to conflicting goals.
Products support goals; goals should not exist merely to sell products.

goals.name: Get day-to-day finances organised
goals.description: Create a stable view of income, spending, bills and everyday cashflow.

discovery_signals.text: my money is all over the place
I don't know where my money goes
I need to organise bills and spending

default_checkins.purpose: Review first month of organised cashflow

goals.name: Build an emergency fund
goals.description: Build an accessible reserve for unexpected costs or income disruption.

discovery_signals.text: I want a rainy day fund

goals.name: Reduce expensive debt
goals.description: Stabilise cashflow and reduce expensive or problematic borrowing.

discovery_signals.text: I want to clear my debt
my card balance is getting out of hand

suppressions: Where the customer cannot meet essentials or is in arrears, prioritise support over new credit.

goals.name: Save for a defined purchase or event
goals.description: Build a known amount by a target date for a specific purpose.

goals.name: Buy first home
goals.description: Move from deposit preparation into mortgage readiness, purchase and completion.

discovery_signals.text: I want to buy my first home

goals.name: Move home
goals.description: Plan the sale and purchase of a new principal home.

goals.name: Renovate or improve home
goals.description: Plan, budget and fund home improvement or retrofit works.

goals.name: Rebuild savings after buying a home
goals.description: Re-establish liquidity after deposit, moving and completion costs.

discovery_signals.text: we used most of our savings buying the house
our cash buffer is low after moving

goals.name: Combine or organise finances with a partner
goals.description: Create a shared structure for bills, spending, saving and joint goals.

goals.name: Prepare financially for a baby
goals.description: Understand parental-leave, childcare, household and dependant impacts.

default_checkins.purpose: Review household finances after baby-related changes

goals.name: Save for a child
goals.description: Build money over time for a child's future or education.

goals.name: Protect family finances
goals.description: Understand who depends on household income and whether financial protection is adequate.

discovery_signals.text: my family relies on my income

suppressions: Do not infer a protection sale from an unrelated medical diagnosis.

goals.name: Protect household income
goals.description: Understand how the household would cope if an earner could not work.

discovery_signals.text: we couldn't manage without my salary

suppressions: Do not use a disclosed diagnosis as a sales trigger.

goals.name: Start career after education
goals.description: Move from student finances into salary, everyday banking and early long-term planning.

goals.name: Respond to a major income change
goals.description: Re-plan finances after promotion, job change, reduced hours or redundancy.
suppressions: If income falls and affordability is stressed, prioritise support over new borrowing.

goals.name: Recover from financial difficulty
goals.description: Stabilise immediate obligations, stop deterioration and rebuild resilience.
suppressions: Suppress playful persona treatment in serious financial distress.

goals.name: Separate finances after relationship breakdown
goals.description: Untangle shared banking and rebuild an individual financial position.

discovery_signals.text: we need to split our finances

suppressions: Suppress humour and inappropriate sales-led cross-sell.

goals.name: Manage an inheritance, bonus or lump sum
goals.description: Allocate a significant one-off sum across immediate needs, debt, savings and long-term goals.

discovery_signals.text: I have a lump sum to manage

suppressions: Do not push investment before near-term liquidity and obligations are understood.

goals.name: Start investing for long-term growth
goals.description: Determine whether genuinely long-term surplus cash should enter an investment suitability journey.

discovery_signals.text: I have money I won't need for years

suppressions: Suppress if money is needed in the short/medium term.
Do not select a specific investment outside the authorised suitability/advice process.

goals.name: Start or improve retirement saving
goals.description: Understand existing retirement provision, target retirement and whether action is needed.

discovery_signals.text: I need to start saving for retirement

goals.name: Prepare for retirement
goals.description: Build a clear picture of retirement income, expenditure, debt and timing.

discovery_signals.text: I'm retiring in a few years
am I on track for retirement

goals.name: Transition into retirement
goals.description: Turn accumulated retirement resources into a sustainable retirement-income and cashflow plan.

discovery_signals.text: what do I do with my pension now

goals.name: Fund education
goals.description: Prepare for tuition and related education costs using savings and borrowing where needed.

discovery_signals.text: I need to pay for university

goals.name: Buy a car
goals.description: Plan and fund a vehicle purchase while understanding impacts on household cashflow and other goals.

discovery_signals.text: we need a bigger car for the family

goals.name: Move to Ireland
goals.description: Set up practical banking and financial arrangements for relocation to Ireland.

goals.name: Manage international money needs
goals.description: Handle recurring or one-off foreign-currency transfers, income or obligations.

life_event_clusters.name: Recently married / combining households
life_event_clusters.notes: Do not assume joint banking is desired; clarify how the couple wants to manage shared and individual money.

life_event_clusters.name: New baby / growing family
life_event_clusters.notes: Broad financial transition, not an automatic insurance trigger.

life_event_clusters.name: First-home life stage
life_event_clusters.notes: New unsecured borrowing may conflict with mortgage affordability.

life_event_clusters.name: Income shock
life_event_clusters.notes: Suppress discretionary borrowing and sales-led prompts.
